app_tool_definitions.description:
Authority-gated Bonfÿre institutional operating system for native tools, work, evidence, finance, CMS, and Matrix operations.

Before implementing, pass paths (up to 16) to inspect current preimage hashes, dirty state and configured write constraints without preparing a patch or writing receipts. Then pass patch for Git validation and low-risk eligibility. Use exactly one of paths or patch. Preflight grants no write authority. This tool is part of plugin `AurekaiBonfyre`.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__codex_apps__aurekaibonfyre_project_patch_preview(args: { patch?: string; paths?: Array<string>; }): Promise<CallToolResult>; };
```

app_tool_definitions.name: mcp__codex_apps__aurekaibonfyre_task_status
app_tool_definitions.description:
Authority-gated Bonfÿre institutional operating system for native tools, work, evidence, finance, CMS, and Matrix operations.

Read durable task state and current service ownership. Prefer detail=summary for bounded polling; full includes agent outputs and receipts. A historical running record without current ownership requires reconciliation, not automatic replay. This tool is part of plugin `AurekaiBonfyre`.

exec tool declaration:
```ts

```
